main_text.p: in ɛ mutando, in barytonis & circumflexis. ut: τύπτω, τύπτεις: ποιέω, ποιεῖς.

Verba autem in μι, convertunt μι in ῥι; & in penultimâ, loco vocalis longæ, resumunt brevem. ut: τίθημι, τίθεις (pro τίθεσθαι: ad vitandum concursum duarum consonantium aspiratarum) ἵστημι, ἵστασθαι: διδῶμι, διδόασθαι: ζεύγνυμι, ζεύγνυσθαι.
Perfectum, formatur à Perfecto indicativo; α mutando in ε. ut: τέτυφα, τετύφεις: πέπομαι: τέθεικα, τέθεικε.
Indefinitum primum, ab Indefinito primo indicativo: α in ον mutando; & augmentum abjiciendo. ut: ἔτυψα, τύψον: ἐποίησα, ποίησον: ἔθηκα, θῆκον.

Indefinitum secundum, ab Indefinito secundo indicativo: ον mutando in ε, in barytonis & circumflexis; vero in ῥι, in verbis in μι: ac utrobique abjiciendo augmentum. ut: ἔτυπον, τύπε: ἐδίδοσαν, δίδου: ἔστην, στῆθι: ἐδίδουν, δίδου.
[Observationes. 1. Quinque hi Imperativi indefiniti, ultimam syllabam acuunt: εἰπέ, ἐλθέ, ἰδέ, ἰδέ, λαβέ.
2. Tria hæc in μι, vocalem longam Indefiniti indicativi commutant in brevem

page.notes: Marginal mark "iii" at right beside the Observationes paragraph. Greek transcribed approximately from the scan; several Greek forms are doubtful and may contain errors. Line ending "in bre-" continues on the next page as "vem".
